morgan: Quick Q — while wiring up the Console flow for variant routing, ran into an odd edge case with guard evaluation order. If we have a latency SLO guard + quota gate + canary weight, do we evaluate quota first or SLO?

nina: Good question. My gut says quota first (deny early) then SLO guard for traffic shaping, but that changes telemetry semantics.

samuel: We currently short-circuit on quota in the routing API today — cheaper to check. But for rollouts we also want to avoid sending traffic that will blow SLOs.

morgan: That's the tension. If quota blocks before SLO, our dashboard will show 0 traffic to variant and the canary looks dead even though SLO would have allowed low qps.

eli: Proposed rule: 1) quick quota check (cheap counters) -> 2) soft-SLO check that returns a score -> 3) final decision uses score + canary weight. Soft-SLO can be cached briefly.

nina: I like soft-SLO as a heuristic. Do we have API representation for a "soft" guard vs "hard" guard?

samuel: Not yet. Current routing policy schema is boolean gates + weights. We could add "guard_type": "hard|soft" and a numeric severity. Example: `{ "guard": "latency_p95", "type": "soft", "threshold_ms": 250, "severity": 0.7 }`

morgan: That adds complexity to the Console UI. How would we surface severity to product managers? Simple slider?

eli: Slider + tooltip. But also expose a compact summary: "Soft guard: may reduce variant traffic to X% under stress". 

samuel: Telemetry-wise we need to emit "guard_decision" events with fields: guard_type, input_metric, decision, sampling_rate. Otherwise rollout metrics will be confusing.

morgan: Agree. Also need a backward-compatibility plan: if older agents don't understand soft guards, they should treat them as hard by default. Add versioned schema.

nina: One more: can we reuse existing quota circuit code? Quota check happens in the fast path; if we add soft-SLO scoring, make sure it runs async where possible to avoid p99 regressions.

deploy-bot: deploy: routing-api v2.14.0 promoted to staging — contains guard_type schema changes.

samuel: Thanks — I'll run canary with a tiny variant (1%) and enable soft-latency guard to observe behavior. Can someone add an ephemeral dashboard tile for the guard_decision events?

eli: I'll add: "Rollout -> Variant guard decisions" tile that shows decisions over time + impact on traffic.

morgan: Ok plan: (1) land schema change behind feature flag, (2) telemetry events + dashboard tile, (3) Console UX slider mock + copy, (4) docs. Sam, can you do the server-side impl and tests?

samuel: Yep, I'll open a PR and tag y'all. Expect initial patch tomorrow. :thumbsup:

nina: If we hit unexpected p99 regressions, we fallback to the old short-circuit behavior automatically. Need a runbook entry.

morgan: Good call. I'll draft a short playbook and add it to the rollout checklist.

eli: One tiny API note — for the soft guard score, let's keep it 0..1 float, and name the field `soft_enforce_score`. Saves future mapping.

samuel: ack. I'll include scaffolding in the PR.

morgan: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: PR link, dashboard tile id, and playbook snippet in this thread when available.
